<thought>We need to construct the retrosynthesis route JSON. The previous steps gave us a template (ID 12345) and its mapped reaction SMILES, but applying the template returned an empty list of precursors, likely because the tool needs the raw template SMARTS. I will retrieve the template details with get_template and then apply it to the target molecule to obtain precursors.</thought>
<action>get_template</action>
<action_input>{"template_id": "12345"}</action_input>
